Stensen excelled at the longer distances, especially the 5,000 m and 10,000 m, and set two world records.  He was World Allround Champion in 1974 and European Allround Champion in 1975.  He also won Olympic gold on the 5,000 m in Innsbruck in 1976.  For his accomplishments, he received the Oscar Mathisen Award in 1974 and 1976.
